restore_parameter_names: restore parameter and buffer names from original nn.module in an FX graph for ONNX export readability
rename_param_and_buffer: rename a parameter or buffer in an FX graph module from a generated name back to its original readable name
build_onnx_readability_pass: build a readability pass that restores original parameter and buffer names to an FX GraphModule before ONNX export
run_readability_transform: run the RestoreParameterAndBufferNames transform on an FX module with its original nn.Module for name restoration
diagnose_unchanged_names: diagnose parameters or buffers in an FX graph that cannot be mapped back to original readable names
